notes:
### Added
- Local crash reports with exception details, runtime data, and process stats.
- Deeplinks to open and download Firebase releases directly from Slack.
- Selectable stable, alpha, and beta update channels.
- Initial Firebase project discovery for multi-game support.
- TeamCity build start and completion notifications for selected users.

### Changed
- Updated the TeamCity iOS development workflow to use the Build & Deploy pipeline.
- Improved release pages with a clearer device installation status, progress feedback, and actions.
- Release layouts now preserve filters, pagination, downloads, and loaded commits when switching views.
- Settings now protect unsaved changes when closing the app and save faster.
- Reduced startup time and memory usage.
